versions.subject: added win_office_spawn_exe_from_users_directory.yml. Detects executable in users directory started via office program. Helpful for adversaries that tend to drop and execute renamed binaries in this location such as fin7

selection:
    ParentImage:
        - '*\WINWORD.EXE'
        - '*\EXCEL.EXE'
        - '*\POWERPNT.exe'
        - '*\MSPUB.exe'
        - '*\VISIO.exe'
        - '*\OUTLOOK.EXE'
    Image:
        - '*\users\*\.exe'
condition: selection
